# Generated by `cargo run -p agent_docs` from the diagnostic registry and compiler/tests/ui; do not edit.
title: "V1012 mixed_union_alternatives"
description: "type X = A | B must be either all existing error tags (an error-union alias) or all new variants."
---

An error from the `resolve` phase. `sakura explain V1012` prints this explanation offline.

`type X = A | B` must be either all existing error tags (an error-union alias) or all new
variants. Mixing the two is ambiguous (design §3.2). Rename the new variant so it does not reuse
an error tag's name, or declare the missing name as an `error` too.

Wrong:

```sakura
error Timeout
type Outcome = Timeout | Done
```

Fixed:

```sakura
error Timeout
type Outcome = Expired | Done
```
